description.value: A renovated boutique motel in the heart of Naramata village, offering 9 micro-suites—4 with kitchenettes—arranged around a xeriscaped courtyard. Originally one of Naramata's earliest roadside motels, it has been reimagined as a self-catering retreat with keyless check-in and modern comforts. The property sits minutes from the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and is within walking distance of the beach, local cafes, and Okanagan wineries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, email, URL). Wi-Fi is confirmed as a room amenity on the Queen Studio page and aligns with the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No mention of secure bike storage, bike-specific procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or most other cycling amenities anywhere on the site; the property uses keyless self-check-in, suggesting limited staff interaction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible boutique accommodation with an active booking system and confirmed contact details; well-positioned for Kettle Valley Rail Trail cyclists.

wow_evidence: boutique motel... minutes from the Kettle Valley Rail Trail
